title: On box dimension of the graphs of the generalized Riemann-type functions
summary: We investigate the box dimension of the graphs of a class of continuous periodic functions $G_δ(x)=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}g(n^{2}x)n^{-1-δ}$ with 1-periodic Lipschitz functions $g$ and $0<δ\le 1$, which generalizes the result of the classical Riemann function corresponding to $g(x)=\sin(2πx)$ and $δ=1$. More precisely, we first prove that the lower box dimension of the graph of $G_δ$ is no less than $\frac74-\fracδ{2}$ when the Fourier coefficients of $g$ satisfy an arithmetic non-vanishing condition related to the distribution of quadratic residues.
